messages:
Sofia J (IC): hey — quick question. Booked flight on company card, took taxi in berlin and tipped driver in cash (EUR). Uploaded the taxi receipt but OCR failed and expense-bot auto-rejected it. Should I re-submit as two lines (card fare + cash tip) or one claim? also what's the best way to show the currency conversion?

expense-bot: Your expense 987654 was auto-rejected: unreadable merchant — please re-upload a legible receipt or add a manual note.

Ava R (People Ops): sorry about the bot — short version: submit one expense thread for the trip but add a manual line for the cash tip. attach the original receipt photo AND a quick photo of the cash slip/handwritten note showing the tip if you have it. in the expense form put: "Taxi + cash tip (EUR)" in the description.

Ava R (People Ops): steps: 1) re-upload the taxi receipt pdf or photo (high-res) 2) in the same expense click "add another expense line" -> choose "Other - Cash Tip" and enter tip amount in EUR 3) in the net amount field put the USD conversion and add exchange rate in the notes (or select auto-convert) 4) in notes add: "Tip paid in cash to driver; attached proof; original fare charged to company card" 5) @Conner will manually approve if OCR previously rejected.

Conner M (Payroll): we can reimburse cash tips. policy stuff: tips for transportation are reimbursable when directly business-related. we need either a receipt showing total (preferred) or a short attestation if none. for exchange rate use the date-of-trip rate from xe.com or the Google rate — just paste the URL or screenshot. we'll reimburse USD equivalent and show it on your pay/expenses.

Sofia J (IC): thanks — I only have the taxi receipt showing the fare (card) and a photo of my cash envelope noting "€5 tip". OCR only picked up the company card line. I'll re-upload both. do i need manager approval?

Liam F (Finance): manager approval not required for tips < $25 equivalent — we treat them as standard travel expenses. if it's > $25 or seems unusual, manager signoff is needed. keep the note with exchange rate.

Ava R (People Ops): if expense-bot keeps rejecting: a) attach one combined PDF (receipt + tip photo) b) in the expense form leave a 1-line explanation c) DM @Conner or reply in this thread with the expense id and we'll mark it for manual review.

Sofia J (IC): perfect, i'll do that. re-uploading now. thx! :thumbsup:

expense-bot: Expense 987654 has been reprocessed and flagged for manual review by Payroll.
